Bounty OG

---

✨ Short Description

A simple, clean, and powerful bounty system for SMP servers with custom effects and rewards.

---

🔥 Full Description

Bounty OG is a lightweight and easy-to-use bounty plugin for Minecraft servers.

It allows admins to put a bounty on any player, turning them into a TARGET for everyone.

- ⚔️ When bounty starts → player becomes TARGET
- 🏹 Other players try to eliminate them
- 🛡️ Target must survive till time ends

🏆 Result:

- ✔️ If target survives → they win
- ✔️ If someone kills target → killer wins

Perfect for SMP servers that want PvP, chaos, and competitive gameplay without complexity.

---

⚡ Features

- ✔️ Simple bounty system
- ✔️ Smart time format → "10s / 10m / 1h"
- ✔️ Auto / Admin reward system
- ✔️ Custom particles & sounds
- ✔️ Bossbar + Actionbar tracking
- ✔️ Real-time updates
- ✔️ Optimized performance

---

🛠️ Commands

- "/bounty add <player> <time>" → Start bounty
- "/bounty stop <player>" → Stop bounty
- "/bounty status" → Check current bounty
- "/bounty reload" → Reload config
